interpretation: Original curated review panels: listed genes are evidence to inspect, not automatic all-positive calling rules; no calibrated classifier is supplied.

panels.label: Pan-neuronal program
panels.notes: Independent curated union for background review, not a literal author rule. RBFOX3 is not universal; assess a coherent multi-gene program and non-neuronal guards. Catalog facts include mixed-source/species priors, not adult-human specificity validation. v1.3: NRGN is supporting evidence only, not an added core route or a universal pan-neuronal requirement.

panels.label: Dopaminergic candidate
panels.notes: Kamath DA triad TH/SLC6A3/SLC18A2 and Siletti TH/DDC/SLC6A3 are complementary source-local panels, not an obligatory four-gene single-cell intersection. DBH/PNMT are contextual catecholamine conflicts, not literal Siletti DA negatives.

panels.label: GABAergic candidate
panels.notes: Original GABA1/GABA2 are alternative source rules. SLC6A5 suggests glycinergic context, not an automatic exclusion of every co-transmitting cell.

panels.label: SLC17A7-associated glutamatergic program
panels.notes: Single transporter program; require neuronal background and cellular concordance before naming identity.

panels.label: SLC17A6-associated glutamatergic program
panels.notes: Does not alone specify brain-region or projection class.

panels.label: SLC17A8-associated program
panels.notes: Preserve as a transmitter-related program; do not equate single-gene expression with an exclusive excitatory class.

panels.label: Glycinergic candidate
panels.notes: Inspect jointly with GAD programs, neuronal background and appropriate anatomy.

panels.label: Serotonergic candidate
panels.notes: TPH2 adult-brain synthesis evidence; do not substitute the ScType TPH1 entry without contextual review. Optional SLC6A4 evidence must retain its separate source.

panels.label: Cholinergic candidate
panels.notes: Curated synthesis/uptake/vesicular program. Siletti and ScType source combinations differ; ACHE alone is not sufficient.

panels.label: Noradrenergic candidate
panels.notes: DBH contextualizes TH-positive cells; do not call every TH-positive cell DA.

panels.label: Adrenergic candidate
panels.notes: Rare/anatomically constrained candidate; require multi-gene and matched-reference evidence.

panels.label: HDC-associated provisional program
panels.notes: Source rule is single-gene; in heterogeneous or low-depth query report provisional HDC-associated program, not a settled type.

panels.label: PVALB-associated cortical interneuron candidate
panels.notes: Adapted review subset, not complete author rule. Not a general midbrain PVALB classifier.

panels.label: SST-associated cortical interneuron candidate
panels.notes: Contextual cortical rule; source negative distinguishes a source-defined subgroup and is not universal SST biology.

panels.label: VIP-associated cortical interneuron candidate
panels.notes: Adult cortical context; peptide expression outside cortex is not this identity.

panels.label: LAMP5-associated cortical interneuron candidate
panels.notes: Separate LAMP5/LHX6-associated context; do not make generic LAMP5-positive calls from one gene.

panels.label: D1 MSN-associated candidate
panels.notes: Adapted review subset; require striatal origin and neuronal/inhibitory background. DRD1 alone does not prove MSN identity.

panels.label: D2 MSN-associated candidate
panels.notes: Not a midbrain dopamine-neuron marker panel; dopamine receptor expression is not dopamine synthesis identity.

panels.label: Purkinje-associated candidate
panels.notes: Author rule cites mouse cerebellar evidence; validate in human query. PVALB is not uniquely cortical.

panels.label: Cerebellar granule-associated candidate
panels.notes: Source categories contain a Glial metadata inconsistency despite neuronal subtype location; retain the conflict, do not copy that taxonomy automatically.

panels.label: SOX6-associated DA program
panels.notes: Assess only after DA core identity. Not proof of SNpc location or vulnerability.

panels.label: CALB1-associated DA program
panels.notes: DA-parent-restricted program, not a standalone cell type or PD protection claim.

panels.label: SOX6/AGTR1-associated DA candidate
panels.notes: Specific study signature after DA confirmation; query expression is not independent evidence of disease vulnerability or anatomical tier.

panels.label: CALB1/TMEM200A-associated DA candidate
panels.notes: Source-specific program requiring DA parent and matched human SNpc reference.

panels.label: HCRT peptide program
panels.notes: Not sufficient to name orexin neurons in a midbrain dataset; inspect anatomy, ambient RNA and cellular concordance.

panels.label: PMCH peptide program
panels.notes: Keep separate from transmitter identity; HCRT/PMCH cluster co-occurrence does not prove one co-expressing type.

panels.label: NPY peptide program
panels.notes: Shared peptide program; not a unique neuron identity.

panels.label: SST peptide program
panels.notes: Distinct from the cortex-restricted SST interneuron panel.

panels.label: VIP peptide program
panels.notes: Distinct from cortex-restricted VIP interneuron identity.

panels.label: Oligodendroglial identity conflict
panels.notes: Coherent lineage evidence is needed; scattered myelin RNA is not enough. SOX10 is a curated extension and is shared with other glia.

panels.label: OPC identity conflict
panels.notes: Do not infer OPC from LHFPL3 alone, even though it appears in ScType Brain OPC row.

panels.label: Astroglial identity conflict
panels.notes: Curated multi-source review program; compare ependymal/vascular programs and neuronal background.

panels.label: Myeloid identity conflict
panels.notes: Broad myeloid review, deliberately not named microglia. Separate CD163/MRC1/F13A1 macrophage and homeostatic microglial evidence.

panels.label: Macrophage-associated identity conflict
panels.notes: Contextual macrophage/BAM candidate, not interchangeable with microglia.

panels.label: Endothelial identity conflict
panels.notes: FLT1 alone is shared; vascular lineage should be coherent.

panels.label: Pericyte-associated identity conflict
panels.notes: CSPG4 is shared with OPC; compare full mural vs oligodendroglial context.

panels.label: Immature/developmental neuronal program
panels.notes: Supplementary broad panel; does not establish adult neurogenesis or a proliferating neuron type.

panels.label: RIT2-enriched neuronal expression program
panels.notes: Study-associated expression program; neuronal parent and comparative enrichment required. Not a fixed cell type, exclusive identity, DA rescue or mandatory RIT2/GALNTL6 coexpression combination.

panels.label: GALNTL6-associated neuronal expression program
panels.notes: Study-associated expression program; neuronal parent and comparative enrichment required. Not a fixed cell type, exclusive identity, DA rescue or mandatory RIT2/GALNTL6 coexpression combination.
